registration.settings_json_variant: When you declare hooks inside `settings.json` instead, wrap the same event map in a top-level `hooks` key

stdin.snippet: Quickstart hook command: jq -r '.tool_input.command' >> ~/.factory/bash-command-log.txt (matcher `Execute`). Tool hook input: {"session_id":"abc123","transcript_path":"/Users/.../.factory/projects/.../session.jsonl","cwd":"/Users/me/project","permission_mode":"off","hook_event_name":"PreToolUse","tool_name":"Create","tool_input":{"file_path":"/Users/me/project/file.txt","content":"file content"}}. 'The exact shape of `tool_input` and `tool_response` depends on the tool.'

deny.quote: Exit code `2` | Blocking or corrective feedback. `PreToolUse` blocks the tool call, `PostToolUse` and `Stop` feed stderr back to Droid ... | `deny` | Blocks the tool call and sends the reason to Droid. (via hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision)

gaps: No Execute-specific stdin JSON example; command_path comes from the doc's own quickstart jq '.tool_input.command' on an Execute matcher
Doc does not state that PreToolUse exit-2 stderr reaches the model; JSON deny reason does ('sends the reason to Droid')
